response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS p FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(p) AS avg_p FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.p) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.p - a.avg_p) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.p > a.avg_p
